meeting.label: Launch sync transcript
meeting.text:
Weekly sync - Acme Connect app launch - Monday 2026-10-19
Attendees: Sara (PM), Tom (Backend), Mei (Design), Luis (Marketing)

Sara: Launch is still planned for November 16. Biggest risk is the payment flow.
Tom: The payment API integration is 80% done. I'll finish it and have it in staging by Friday. It's blocking QA, so it's urgent.
Mei: Usability tests showed people miss the 'upgrade plan' button. I'll redesign it - give me until next Wednesday.
Luis: We agreed to drop the TV ad and focus on social media. I'll send the revised media plan to Sara by the end of this week.
Sara: Good. Decision: the launch date stays November 16. Also, we will not support Android 9 devices anymore.
Tom: Someone should update the FAQ for the new plans.
Sara: I'll take the FAQ, low priority, by the end of the month.
